from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """A single legal document extracted from the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the document (e.g., '判决文书 1')")
    doc_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of legal document (e.g., '判决书', '裁定书')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The stated cause of action in the document (e.g., '继承纠纷', '劳动争议')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
